text.p: Ameritech Corp chairman, president and chief executive Richard Notebaert was paid about $2.76 million in 1996 plus stock options, up from $2.60 million in 1995, the company said in its proxy statement.
Notebaert received stock options for 370,000 shares. In 1995, he received 135,000 stock options.

Ameritech said Notebaert was paid a salary of $950,000 and a bonus of $1.01 million. Other compensation, including payments to offset tax on transportation, club memberships, as well as savings plans and interest on insurance premiums, totaled $421,077. He also received a long-term incentive payment of $384,660.
In 1995, Notebaert was paid a salary of $880,000 and a bonus of $1.03 million, plus other compensation totaling $338,973 and an incentive payment of $348,898.

Oren Shaffer, chief financial officer of Ameritech, was paid in 1996 a salary of $450,000, a bonus of $340,633 and other compensation of $262,114, totaling $1.05 million. In 1995, he received a total of $1.12 million, with his base salary accounting for $440,000.
Shaffer also received 40,000 stock options in 1996, compared with 44,300 options in 1995.
